A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to evictions of older adult tenants

Resolution calling upon the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.2220/A.5232, which would allow municipalities and localities that have a senior citizen rent increase exemption program to establish an automatic enrollment program for eligible seniors to be automatically enrolled or automatically re-enrolled in the program
Items.MatterName: Allow municipalities and localities that have a senior citizen rent increase exemption program to establish an automatic enrollment program. (S.2220/A.5232)
